sys_scope.name: SkillBridge
sys_scope.description: Scans developer-authored artifacts, maps ServiceNow-specific patterns to transferable skills, and generates professional portfolios (Markdown, JSON, LinkedIn).

sys_user_role.name: x_snc_skb.user
sys_user_role.description: SkillBridge User — can scan, view snapshots, and export portfolios

sys_user_role.name: x_snc_skb.admin
sys_user_role.description: SkillBridge Admin — can manage scan configurations and delete snapshots

sys_ws_definition.name: SkillBridge Execute
sys_ws_definition.description: POST endpoint for scan, export, and compare operations

sys_ws_definition.name: SkillBridge Status
sys_ws_definition.description: GET endpoint for scan status and health check
